findings.evidence: answer_feedback_request locks the row with SELECT ... FOR UPDATE but never checks v_request.request_status = 'PENDING'; the UPDATE and the FEEDBACK_ANSWERED INSERT run for ANSWERED/CLOSED rows too. The same body is in sql/SCHEMA.sql.
findings.impact: Two admins answering the same feedback (or a retried call) overwrite the first answer and create a second notification for the user. The other six request RPCs reject non-PENDING rows, so this RPC is inconsistent with them.
findings.recommendation: Raise an exception when v_request.request_status <> 'PENDING' (as approve_*_request does), mirror it in SCHEMA.sql and add a TESTS.sql check that a second answer fails without a second notification.

findings.evidence: The R84 smoke block covers feedback RLS, answer_feedback_request, mark_notifications_read, purge and anon access, but no call to approve_/reject_ game/schedule/character_request checks that a REQUEST_APPROVED/REQUEST_REJECTED notification row is created for the requester (the only REQUEST_APPROVED rows are fixture inserts).
findings.impact: Acceptance criterion 3 (atomic notification inside the six existing RPCs) is verified only by reading code; a regression in any of the six rewritten RPC bodies would not be caught by the local DB run.
findings.recommendation: Add at least one approve and one reject case (for example game_requests) that asserts exactly one notification with the expected kind, user_id and source_id, and that the reject body does not contain admin_memo.

findings.evidence: The notification title is always '건의에 답변이 등록되었습니다', also for p_status = 'CLOSED' where the answer may be empty; only the body changes.
findings.impact: A user whose feedback was closed without an answer sees a title saying an answer was registered.
findings.recommendation: Use a CLOSED-specific title (for example '건의 검토가 종료되었습니다') in both the migration and SCHEMA.sql.

findings.evidence: The R84 row warns only about re-running older purge migrations. MIGRATION_R33_SCHEDULE_RERUN_AND_BROADCAST.sql, MIGRATION_R52_CHARACTER_TEMPLATE_AND_PICKUP_AVATAR.sql and MIGRATION_UNOFFICIAL_SCHEDULES.sql also redefine approve/reject request RPCs without the notification INSERT.
findings.impact: Re-applying one of those files later silently removes request approval/rejection notifications.
findings.recommendation: Extend the warning to name the migrations that redefine the six request RPCs.

findings.evidence: formatCreatedAt uses Date#getMonth/getDate/getHours, i.e. the device time zone, while the app shows dates in KST (calendar-utils.ts, dashboard-date.ts).
findings.impact: On a device outside KST the inbox time differs from the rest of the app.
findings.recommendation: Format with the existing KST helpers or Intl.DateTimeFormat with timeZone 'Asia/Seoul'.
